### Summary

Signal reactions could bind to the wrong approval. In affected versions, an approval reaction could attach to ordinary outbound text instead of the structured approval request it was intended to resolve.

This advisory is scoped to Signal approval reactions when unrelated outbound messages and a pending approval were present in the same conversation. It does not change the authority of correctly identified approvers.

### Impact

A reaction to unrelated text could be interpreted as approving or denying a pending host action. Practical impact depends on the pending request, conversation timing, and actions available to the OpenClaw process.

### Patched Versions

The first stable patched version is `2026.7.1`.

### Mitigations

upgrade to `openclaw@2026.7.1` or later. Before upgrading, avoid reaction-based approvals in Signal, use another approval surface, and cancel pending requests when unrelated messages appear.
